create_parser_kimi_k2: create a Kimi K2 tool call parser that extracts structured tool_calls from raw model output text with <|tool_call_begin|> markers
parse_kimi_k2_output: parse Kimi K2 raw model output text to extract content and a list of ChatCompletionMessageToolCall objects
register_parser_kimi_k2: register the KimiK2ToolCallParser class under the name 'kimi_k2' using the @register_parser decorator
get_parser_kimi_k2: get the Kimi K2 parser instance by calling get_parser('kimi_k2') from the tool_call_parsers registry
parse_multiple_tool_calls: parse multiple <|tool_call_begin|> blocks from Kimi K2 output, extracting function names and JSON arguments from each
